title: Permission decisions
use_case: Decide only when Codex is about to request approval.
action: Launch this scenario in read-only sandbox mode (the launcher does this). Ask: Execute exactly `python3 write_marker.py`; if the sandbox rejects the write, request approval to rerun it with elevated permissions. Do not use another mechanism.
evidence: PermissionRequest denies the escalation and .demo/write-marker.txt remains absent.
caveat: Depends on approval policy and a real escalation. No approval request means no event. policy.txt can be deny, allow, or abstain; restart after changes if required by trust review. Allow is restricted to the exact local simulation command.
